usage.label: Use
usage.notEnforced: Disk limits are not enforced on this server: its file system has no project quota.
usage.full: The site has used 95 % or more of a disk limit. When it is full, writing new files fails.
usage.dbFull: The databases have reached 95 % of the warning size. They keep growing and fill the server's disk: clean them up or raise the value.

inputs.memoryHint: MiB for PHP, cron jobs and other processes of the site
inputs.workersHint: Requests the site's PHP handles at the same time, {{min}} to {{max}}
inputs.priorityHint: The share of the CPU the site gets when the server is busy
inputs.coresHint: Hard limit, such as 2 or 0.5. 0 means no hard limit: the site may use every free core, and only the CPU priority decides its share when the server is busy.
inputs.dbSizeHint: GiB for all local databases of the site. Only a warning: databases can grow past it
inputs.dbConnectionsHint: At the same time, per database user
inputs.unlimitedWarning: An unlimited value lets this site fill the disk or take the memory of the whole server. Use it only for a site you trust.

site.applyError: The limits are saved but could not be applied on the server: {{error}}. Save again to retry.
site.notSet: This site has no limits yet: it was created before limits existed. Choose a preset to limit it.

presets.title: Limit presets
presets.description: A new site gets the default preset. Changing a preset changes every site that uses it; a site with custom values stays as it is.
presets.newDescription: A preset is a named set of limits for sites.
presets.changeDescription: Sites that use this preset get the new values.
presets.saved: Preset {{name}} saved. Sites that use it get the new values.
presets.madeDefault: New sites now get the preset {{name}}.

delete.title: Delete the preset {{name}}?
delete.text: Its sites keep the values as custom values.

form.name: Name
form.cachesHint: A site that gets this preset, when it is created, imported or switched to it, starts with these settings. Changing them here later only changes the size for sites that follow the preset and have the cache on; it never turns a cache on or off.
form.objectCacheHint: Valkey for the site's PHP, on a socket only the site can open. At most half of the memory limit.
form.pageCacheHint: nginx keeps whole PHP pages, with the strict preset for any application. Cached pages count against the disk limit.

problems.cacheHalf: The object cache may take at most half of the memory limit ({{n}} MiB).
problems.presetName: A preset name has 1 to 32 lower-case letters, digits and dashes.
problems.coresFormat: CPU cores must be a number such as 2 or 0.5, or 0 for no limit.
problems.coresMax: CPU cores must be at most {{max}}.
problems.defaultUnlimited: The default preset must limit disk space, files, memory and processes.

errors.presetNotFound: This preset does not exist any more. Reload the page.
errors.limits_unavailable: Resource limits are not available on this panel.
errors.preset_exists: A preset with this name exists. Choose another name.
errors.preset_is_default: This is the default preset. Make another preset the default first.
errors.forbidden: Only administrators can manage resource limits.
